info.name: Posit Connect API Reference API Keys Bootstrap API
Create first administrator and API key

items.docs:
This endpoint creates an initial administrator user, provisions an API key for the initial administrator,
and returns the API key. This endpoint only functions for installations with no pre-existing users.

#### Code samples

::: {.panel-tabset}

##### curl

```bash
#!/bin/bash

BOOTSTRAP_JWT="your.jwt.here"

curl --silent --show-error -L --max-redirs 0 --fail \
    -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Connect-Bootstrap ${BOOTSTRAP_JWT}" \
    "https://connect.example.com/__api__/v1/bootstrap"
```
